name: baggage-quiz-app
description: Baggage Security Quiz Application - Full Stack MERN App

scripts.vercel-build: cd client && npm ci && npm run build && cd .. && node build.js
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.heroku-postbuild: npm run install:all && npm run build
scripts.electron:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development concurrently "npm run client:dev" "wait-on http://localhost:3000 && electron electron/main.js"

author: Baggage Quiz Team
